constraints.text: Do not add spoken or sung lines.

claims.text: The car pulls forward out of the dark.
A wide exterior setting with pavement, heavy shadow, and a dim pool of light is used to stage the reveal.
Low engine rumble and soft tire roll support the car's forward movement.

description.text: A wide exterior view opens in near darkness. Most of the frame is a deep, matte black, broken only by a faint, cool sheen on the pavement and a low horizon of indistinct shapes that suggest an empty street or lot. The air feels still and dense. At first the car is only a darker mass at the far edge of visibility: a low silhouette with a suggestion of a roofline, a front end, and the soft glint of one surface catching the smallest amount of ambient light. The pavement beneath it is smooth and slightly reflective, holding a thin smear of pale illumination that does not reach far. As the car begins to move, the shape separates from the background. The front bumper, hood, and windshield edge resolve gradually, not as a sudden reveal but as a slow accumulation of detail: the shallow curve of the hood, the dark band of the grille, the faint highlight running along one side. The car advances at a steady, deliberate pace, keeping a straight line toward the foreground. Its tires roll quietly over the pavement, and the low engine note deepens as the vehicle draws closer, filling the quiet without becoming loud. By the middle of the shot, the car has entered a dim pool of light. The light is soft and narrow, enough to mark the edges of the bodywork and to show the texture of the road, but not enough to flatten the scene into daylight. Shadows remain heavy around the car and across the background. The car continues forward, its shape growing larger and clearer in the frame. The movement is calm and continuous, with no sudden turn or stop. Near the end, the car is fully present in the dim light, still facing the viewer and still advancing, while the surrounding darkness stays close at the edges of the frame. The overall effect is a measured emergence from shadow, with the car's forward motion and the gradual reveal of its form carrying the entire shot.
The frame opens on a wide, dark exterior. Most of the image is deep shadow, with only faint pavement highlights and indistinct background shapes.
A car sits at the far edge of visibility, its silhouette barely separable from the darkness.
A low engine rumble begins, quiet and steady.
The car eases forward, holding a straight line toward the foreground. Its hood and front fascia start to resolve from the shadow.
As the car enters a dim pool of light, the bodywork gains a soft sheen. The grille, windshield edge, and the highlight along one side become visible.
The car continues its steady advance. The gap between it and the viewer closes at a measured pace.
Soft tire roll over pavement becomes clearer, while the engine rumble deepens slightly as the car draws nearer.
The car is now clearly seen in the dim light, still moving forward. Heavy shadow remains around it and across the background.

soundscape: Low engine rumble and soft tire roll over pavement.
